method.unit: one original audit group, not estimated hours, screens or individual assertions
method.locallyAddressed: The main local change is present and supported by source/retained scoped evidence. This is not final acceptance of every stated variant.
method.partial: Some work exists, but a specified implementation or required review is unfinished.
method.open: The specific audit work remains open; the underlying application feature may already exist.
method.reviewNeeded: The audit explicitly lacks adequate baseline review; review first rather than inventing a rewrite.
method.completionRule: Do not use implementation coverage as audit completion or reuse the roughly80% V1 coding estimate. Full goal completion additionally requires unfinished approved V1 functionality outside this audit.
method.validatorLimit: Coverage/link validation checks this inventory; it does not prove visual correctness or completed requirements.
method.evidenceFingerprint: SHA-256 of UTF-8 text with CRLF normalized to LF; no other whitespace normalization. The original audit hash uses original bytes.

globalAcceptance:
## Sequence and acceptance

1. Standardize shared controls, record headers and responsive list/detail navigation.
2. Finish Today, planner, saved jobs and per-vehicle field tasks.
3. Finish quote modes, scoped accounting, documents and evidence timelines.
4. Verify every important loading, empty, invalid, denied, stale, uncertain and successful state on the exact release; include a physical iPhone.

Do not hide incomplete accounting coverage, change accepted/posted history, imply messaging or calendar success, or default unfinished work to completed. Full view-specific acceptance details and four illustrative concepts are in index.html.

Review gaps: fresh signed-in planner; eligible cancel/interruption; full loaded/denied expense states; real file handling; accounting opening/setup flows; integration failure states; physical iPhone. All are still required for product sign-off.
